name: Landscape Design IV
brief: Develop a landscape-led transformation strategy for the former Yunuseli airfield and its surrounding urban landscape. Examine the relationships between housing, industry, agriculture, water systems and the wider forest landscape. Investigate climate resilience and urban metabolism, ecological continuity, food security, health, green industrial transition and waste reduction as possible lenses, not predetermined programme requirements. Translate the course's climate-agenda framing into evidence-based spatial proposals. Research the actual site, users, infrastructure and environmental constraints before selecting a programme. Develop regional/site analysis, a 1:5000 strategy, then more detailed 1:1000 and 1:500 design work where appropriate; scales are study targets, not certified geometry. Each student chooses and supports their own design question, programme and spatial strategy. No specific productive-park concept, personal jury feedback or previous student's proposal is included.
provenance: Neutral paraphrase of the supplied Landscape Design IV course description and scale progression. This is a starter summary, not the official syllabus. Upload the current course syllabus and verified site data; the climate-agenda reference is a course theme, not a verified event-location claim.
